import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem bounded_positional_multiplier_balance
  (base lead unit k : ℕ)
  (hbase : 1 < base)
  (hlead : 1 ≤ lead)
  (hlead_lt : lead < base)
  (hunit_lt : unit < base)
  (hk : k ≤ base) :
  k * (Nat.digits base (base * lead + unit)).sum = base * lead + unit ↔
    (base - k) * lead = (k - 1) * unit := by
  have hdigit :
      Nat.digits base (base * lead + unit) =
        unit :: Nat.digits base lead := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm (base * lead) unit]
    exact Nat.digits_add base hbase unit lead hunit_lt
      (Or.inr (Nat.ne_of_gt hlead))
  
  have hdecomp :
      (Nat.digits base (base * lead + unit)).sum = lead + unit := by
    rw [hdigit, Nat.digits_of_lt base lead (Nat.ne_of_gt hlead) hlead_lt]
    simp [Nat.add_comm]
  
  have hfixed_balance :
      k * (lead + unit) = base * lead + unit ↔
        (base - k) * lead = (k - 1) * unit := by
    by_cases hkzero : k = 0
    · subst k
      have hprod : 0 < base * lead := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hlead
      constructor <;> intro h <;> simp at h <;> omega
    · have hkpos : 1 ≤ k := by omega
      have hklead : k * lead ≤ base * lead :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right lead hk
      have hunit : unit ≤ k * unit := by
        calc
          unit = 1 * unit := by simp
          _ ≤ k * unit := Nat.mul_le_mul_right unit hkpos
      constructor
      · intro h
        simp only [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.one_mul]
        rw [Nat.mul_add] at h
        omega
      · intro h
        simp only [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.one_mul] at h
        rw [Nat.mul_add]
        omega
  
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [hdecomp] at h
    exact hfixed_balance.mp h
  · intro h
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact hfixed_balance.mpr h

theorem bounded_positional_multiplier_balance

  (hbase : 1 < base)
  (hlead : 1 ≤ lead)
  (hlead_lt : lead < base)
  (hunit_lt : unit < base)
  (hk : k ≤ base) :
  k * (Nat.digits base (base * lead + unit)).sum = base * lead + unit ↔
    (base - k) * lead = (k - 1) * unit := by
  have hdigits : Nat.digits base (base * lead + unit) = [unit, lead] := by
    rw [show base * lead + unit = unit + base * lead by omega]
    rw [Nat.digits_add base hbase unit lead hunit_lt]
    · rw [Nat.digits_of_lt base lead (by omega) hlead_lt]
    · omega
  rw [hdigits]
  simp only [List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, Nat.mul_add]
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · subst k
    have hbprod : 0 < base * lead := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hlead
    simp
    omega
  have hklead : k * lead ≤ base * lead :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right lead hk
  have hunitmul : unit ≤ k * unit := by
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left unit (by omega)
  rw [Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.sub_mul]
  omega
